name: JA_CN_TRX_HEADERS_ALL
description: This table contains transaction header information.

columns.name: GTA_TRX_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key that identifies a row in this table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: GTA_TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Group number of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: Version number of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of a Golden Tax transaction. The statuses are DRAFT, CONSOLIDATED, GENERATED, FAILED, COMPLETED and CANCELED.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATION_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates the level of consolidation of a transaction. The values are: 0 for a normal transaction; 1 for a consolidated parent transaction; 2 for a consolidated child transaction.

columns.name: CONSOLI_PARENT_TRX_HDR_ID
columns.description: Consolidation parent transaction header identifier.

columns.name: SPLIT_FLAG
columns.description: Option to split a Receivables transaction into several Golden Tax transactions during transfer.

columns.name: GENERATOR_ID
columns.description: Generator identifier for the generator process.

columns.name: EXPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Export request identifier for the export process.

columns.name: VAT_BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Golden Tax transactions for China VAT invoice batch number.

columns.name: RULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Transfer rule header identifier.

columns.name: INVOICE_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup code for VAT invoice type. SPECIAL indicates a Special Invoice Type. COMMON indicates a Common Invoice Type. ALL indicates both Common and Special Invoice Types.

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Tax code for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for a Golden Tax transaction tax.

columns.name: SALES_LIST_FLAG
columns.description: Option to include a a sales list document with a VAT invoice.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: GL_PERIOD
columns.description: Accounting period of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill-to customer identifier for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill-to customer account number.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of a bill-to customer on a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: RA_TRX_ID
columns.description: Receivables transaction identifier.

columns.name: RA_TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of a Receivables transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_PHONE
columns.description: Address and telephone number of a customer.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: FP_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: First party tax registration number.

columns.name: TP_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Third party tax registration number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name of a customer bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of a customer bank account.

columns.name: RA_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Golden Tax transactions for China Receivables transaction currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion type for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Conversion date for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Original amount of a Receivables transaction.

columns.name: RA_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document number of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: RA_TRX_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Receivables transaction batch identifier.

columns.name: RA_TRX_SOURCE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Receivables transaction source sequence identifier.

columns.name: RA_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Receivables transaction type sequence identifier.

columns.name: RA_TRX_CLASS
columns.description: Receivables transaction class: Invoice, Credit Memo or Debit Memo.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SALESREP_ID
columns.description: Primary salesperson identifier.

columns.name: REVIEWER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the reviewer of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: PAYEE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payee of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
